terms.label: Negatives
terms.scope: Photographs in which the tonal values are the opposite of those in the subject to which the negative was exposed. Their purpose is to be a matrix for obtaining multiple positive images of the subject.

terms.label: Photographic prints
terms.scope: Photographs produced from negatives, by transfer photo processes, or, in the case of photograms, by the direct action of light on light-sensitive paper. Tonal values are usually the same as those of the subject shown. Do not confuse with continuous tone photomechanical prints, such as COLLOTYPES and WOODBURYTYPES.

terms.label: Dry plate negatives
terms.scope: Silver gelatin dry plate negatives were the dominant glass negative ca. 1880-1920. Dry plate negatives were made as early as the 1850s with collodion, honey, and other solutions, but they were not commercially successful and are difficult to distinguish from collodion wet plate negatives.

terms.label: Portrait photographs
terms.scope: For formal, posed studio portraits, as well as informal, candid photographs of persons in natural or spontaneous situations.

terms.label: Men
terms.scope: This heading may be further subdivided by the subdivisions used for classes of persons (Appendix A). Search also under the subdivision --MEN used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups (Appendix A).

terms.label: Portraits
terms.scope: Graphic representations, especially of the face, of real persons, usually posed, living or dead. Pictures whose purpose is the portrayal of an individual or several people, not pictures that merely include people as part of an event or scene.

terms.label: Albumen prints
terms.scope: Predominant paper print photographic process in the 1800s; popular 1850s-1890s.

terms.label: Gelatin silver prints
terms.scope: Photographic prints made by several formulas; introduced in the 1880s; dominant black-and-white photographic print process since the 1890s. Includes various common developing-out papers that are very difficult to distinguish by visual inspection (e.g., bromide, chloride or gaslight, and chloro-bromide) and one printing-out process.

terms.label: Women
terms.scope: This heading may be further subdivided by the subdivisions used for classes of persons (Appendix A). Search also under other headings beginning with WOMEN or WOMEN'S. Search also under the subdivision --WOMEN used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups (Appendix A) and with names of wars (Appendix C).

terms.label: Nitrate negatives
terms.scope: Negatives with a nitrocellulose film base. Manufactured from 1887 to 1950.

terms.label: Photographic postcards
terms.scope: Postcards that are photographs. Kodak introduced a sensitized postcard-size stock with standard postcard information printed on the back in 1902. The format remained popular through about 1920, and is still available. Commercial names include Velox and Azo (from Kodak) and Cyko (from Ansco).

terms.label: Buildings
terms.scope: For buildings in general; includes buildings with indeterminate functions and buildings distinguished by attributes other than function. Search under other FACILITIES NTs for buildings that serve particular functions (e.g., AGRICULTURAL FACILITIES). Search also under the subdivision -- STRUCTURES used with ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and classes of persons (Appendix A). Search also under the subdivision --BUILDINGS used with names of corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

terms.label: Cities & towns
terms.scope: For images that focus on structures and sites. Search under CITY & TOWN LIFE for images that focus on activities.

terms.label: Children
terms.scope: Includes ages 0-18. This heading may be further subdivided by the subdivisions used for classes of persons (Appendix A). Search also under the subdivision --CHILDREN used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups (Appendix A), and with names of wars (Appendix C). Search also under other headings beginning with CHILDREN.

terms.label: Slides
terms.scope: Transparent materials on which there is a drawn image or a positive photographic image; intended to be bound or held in a mount and usually designed for use in a projector or viewer.

terms.label: Transparencies
terms.scope: Sheets of transparent material, such as glass, thin paper, or plastic, bearing a photographic, printed, or hand-drawn image and designed to be viewed by light shining through them; often intended for use with a projection device.

terms.label: Streets
terms.scope: For thoroughfares in cities, towns, and villages. Search under CITY & TOWN LIFE for images that focus on activities. Search under ROADS for thoroughfares outside of cities, towns, and villages.

terms.label: Cartes de visite
terms.scope: Card photographs; mounts measure approximately 4 x 2.5 in. (10 x 6 cm.). Introduced in the United States in 1859; made into the 1900s.

terms.label: Stereographs
terms.scope: Two nearly identical photographs or photomechanical prints, paired to produce the illusion of a single three-dimensional image; usually viewed with a stereoscope. Typically, photographic prints on card mounts, but may be daguerreotypes, glass negatives, slides or other processes. Card mounts commonly 3.5 x 7 in. (9 x 18 cm.) up to 5 x 7 in. (12 x 18 cm.). Popular in the United States 1859-1920s.

terms.label: People
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --PEOPLE used with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

terms.label: Group portraits
terms.scope: Portraits in which two or more people are shown. Includes groups assembled through photomontage, combination printing techniques, or an artist's imagination.

terms.label: Roads
terms.scope: For thoroughfares outside of cities, towns, and villages. Search under STREETS for thoroughfares in cities, towns, and villages.

terms.label: Lantern slides
terms.scope: Hand-drawn, painted, or photographic images on glass, intended for viewing by projection; often made in sets. Photographic lantern slides were introduced in the United States by 1850 and popular through World War I; commonly 3.25 x 4 in. (9 x 10 cm.) with a black paper mask, a cover glass, and taped edges.

terms.label: Cityscapes
terms.scope: General or broad views of cities and towns or sections of them. Usually made from an elevated or distant vantage point, such as a view from a roof or a view of a skyline.

terms.label: Black & white photographs
terms.scope: A general designation that encompasses a variety of photographic processes that produce images in gray, black and white, or sepia tones.

terms.label: Harbors
terms.scope: Small bays or other sheltered parts of a considerable body of water, usually protected either naturally or artificially, for mooring vessels.

terms.label: Carriages & coaches
terms.scope: Vehicles, drawn by animals, used primarily for the transport of people.

terms.label: Bridges
terms.scope: Structures erected over a depression or obstacle, as over a river, gorge, roadway, etc., carrying a roadway and/or walkway for vehicles or persons. Search under SWING BRIDGES for bridges that move horizontally and under VERTICAL LIFT BRIDGES for bridges that lift vertically.

terms.label: Costumes
terms.scope: For clothing or accessories used to disguise or to take on another identity, including clothing of another time or place. Search also under THEATRICAL PRODUCTIONS, as well as ACTORS and ACTRESSES for people in costume. For people in traditional dress search under the subdivision CLOTHING & DRESS used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix B).

terms.label: Ships
terms.scope: For large sea-going vessels used on oceans or inland waterways.

terms.label: Girls
terms.scope: Females, ages 0-16.

terms.label: Boys
terms.scope: Males, ages 0-16.

terms.label: Cabinet photographs
terms.scope: Card photographs; mounts measure approximately 6.5 x 4.25 in. (16.5 x 10.5 cm.). Introduced in the United States in 1866; popular until ca. 1900.

terms.label: Wet collodion negatives
terms.scope: Dominant glass negative process from its introduction in the United States ca. 1855 until replaced by a dry plate process in the 1880s. Its use continued for photolithographic printing plates until World War II. Distinguishable in part by creamy rather than grayish black tones and by presence of flow lines from hand coating of the emulsion.

terms.label: Soldiers
terms.scope: Persons engaged in the military below officer's level. For images of soldiers and troops in the context of war, search under the names of specific wars and relevant topical subdivisions such as --MILITARY PERSONNEL (Appendix C).

terms.label: Indigenous peoples
terms.scope: This heading may be further subdivided by the subdivisions used for classes of persons (Appendix A). See also Library of Congress Subject Headings for names of specific groups.

terms.label: Families
terms.scope: Groups of people identified by family relationship. Search also under the subdivision --FAMILY used with names of persons (Appendix B).

terms.label: Cyanotypes
terms.scope: Blue photographic prints employing light-sensitive iron salts, most commonly on paper; introduced in the 1840s but not in general use until after 1880; often used as proofs.

terms.label: Churches
terms.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

terms.label: Postcards
terms.scope: Cards on which a message may be written or printed for mailing without an envelope; often include a pictorial, comic, or other scene on one side.

terms.label: Palms
terms.scope: Includes palm trees, leaves, and branches.

terms.label: Croplands
terms.scope: Land that is suited to or used for crops.

terms.label: Huts
terms.scope: Simple shelters often roughly built using available raw materials. Often temporary in nature.

terms.label: Cliffs
terms.scope: Very steep, perpendicular, or overhanging faces of rock, earth, or glacial ice of considerable height. Search under CANYONS for images that focus on valleys between cliffs.

terms.label: Panoramic photographs
terms.scope: Photographs which are a continuous view of a wider section of the horizon than could normally be photographed in a single exposure; ratio of width to height is usually 2:1 or more. May be separate photographs either joined (or meant to be joined) together or one long piece made with a special camera.

terms.label: Farms
terms.scope: For tracts of land or water devoted to agricultural purposes.

terms.label: Reproductions
terms.scope: Copies of any image, object, or document that are faithful imitations and made without the intent to deceive. Often made by a mechanical technique, such as photographic or print making processes. They can be in another medium, e.g., engraving of a painting, or of a different size from the original.

terms.label: Carts & wagons
terms.scope: Vehicles, drawn by animal or man or pushed, primarily for the transportation of goods. Search under CARRIAGES & COACHES for vehicles used primarily to transport people.

terms.label: Mills
terms.scope: A facility devoted to processing of materials, e.g. grain to flour, trees to lumber.

terms.label: Geysers
terms.scope: Eruptive springs from which hot water, steam, and/or mud are periodically spurted.

terms.label: Reflections
terms.scope: For images reflected by a surface such as water or a mirror.

terms.label: Landscapes (Representations)
terms.scope: General or broad views of natural scenery, including inland bodies of water; may also include figures or man-made objects, but these are of secondary importance to the composition. Usually made from an elevated or distant vantage point, such as a view from a hill; not ground level close-up view of, for example, a tree.

terms.label: Villages
terms.scope: A unit of compact settlement, usually larger than a hamlet and smaller than a town, and distinguished from a surrounding rural area.

terms.label: Specimens
terms.scope: Individual samples or units that are deliberately selected for examination, display, or study, and are usually chosen as typical of their kind.

terms.label: City & town life
terms.scope: For images that focus on activities. Search under CITIES & TOWNS for images that focus on structures and sites. Search under STREETS for thoroughfares in cities, towns, and villages.

terms.label: Logs
terms.scope: For images that focus on bulky and long segments of tree trunks. Search under FUELWOOD for pieces of smaller trunks and branches to be used for fires. Search under WOODCUTTING for activities.

terms.label: Canyons
terms.scope: For valleys between precipitous walls. Search under CLIFFS for very steep, perpendicular, or overhanging faces of rock, earth, or glacial ice of considerable height.

terms.label: Hotels
terms.scope: Includes structures and activities. Search under HOTEL EMPLOYEES for images where the focus is on employees. Search under RESORTS for resort complexes.

terms.label: Ruins
terms.scope: For remains of structures not of ancient times that have been destroyed or are in a state of great disrepair or decay. Search under ARCHAEOLOGICAL SITES for ancient structures still largely intact, remains of ancient structures, and any active excavations. Search under ABANDONED BUILDINGS for vacant, possibly dilapidated buildings. Search under DISASTERS or WAR DAMAGE for structures ruined by particular events.

terms.label: Sculpture
terms.scope: Primarily for representations of figures in the round, sculptured or modeled out of some solid substance, such as wood, stone, marble, or wax. Includes statues and indoor and outdoor sculpture of all kinds. Search under MODELING (SCULPTURE), STONE CARVING and WOOD CARVING for activities. Search also under the subdivision --STATUES used with names of persons (Appendix B).

terms.label: Fjords
terms.scope: Narrow deep inlets of the sea between cliffs or steep slopes.

terms.label: Clothing & dress
terms.scope: Search also under groups of people associated with particular types of clothing, e.g., FLAPPERS and COWBOYS. Search also under the subdivision --CLOTHING & DRESS used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

terms.label: Carbon prints
terms.scope: Photographic prints made by a relatively permanent, non-silver process involving bichromated gelatin. Popular ca. 1870-1900; more common in Europe than United States; often used to reproduce art works. Typically carbon black, but a wide range of other pigments may also be used.

terms.label: Porches
terms.scope: Covered entrances to buildings, usually with a separate roof.

terms.label: Anglican churches
terms.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

terms.label: Brides
terms.scope: For images which focus on persons, search under WEDDINGS for activities.

terms.label: Railroads
terms.scope: For the subject of railroads and general views of trains. Search under RAILROAD COMPANIES for organizations that operate railroads.

terms.label: Gelatin silver printing-out paper prints
terms.scope: Prints having gelatin as the binder, holding silver as the final image material. Introduced in the 1880s; still marketed as studio proof paper.

terms.label: Cathedrals
terms.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

terms.label: Exhibitions
terms.scope: Includes activities and general views. Search under EXHIBITION BUILDINGS for images that focus on structures. Search also under the subdivision --EXHIBITIONS used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A); names of persons (Appendix B); and names of wars (Appendix C). Search also under the subdivision --EXHIBITIONS & DISPLAYS used with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

terms.label: Monuments & memorials
terms.scope: Structures erected to commemorate persons, events, or causes. Search also under the subdivision --COMMEMORATION used with ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A), and with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D). Search also under the subdivision --MONUMENTS used with names of persons (Appendix B) and with names of wars (Appendix C).

terms.label: Bathing suits
terms.scope: For images in which swimming attire is prominent.

terms.label: Uniforms
terms.scope: Includes uniforms for sports and schools.

terms.label: Factories
terms.scope: Facilities devoted primarily to manufacturing of products or processing of materials. Search under INDUSTRY (or NTs) for activities.

terms.label: Lampposts
terms.scope: Posts usually supporting outdoor lamps or lanterns.

terms.label: Commercial facilities
terms.scope: For facilities associated with the various activities involved in conducting business or trade.

terms.label: Dwellings
terms.scope: Structures designed or used as the living quarters for one or more families. Search under BIRTHPLACES for dwellings that were a place of birth and under ESTATES for grounds and outbuildings associated with dwellings. Search also under the subdivision --STRUCTURES used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A). Search also under the subdivision --HOMES & HAUNTS used with names of persons (Appendix B).

terms.label: Photographs
terms.scope: The word PHOTOGRAPHS is a general designation for any photographic process. The narrower terms include both physical media and genre categories.

terms.label: Steeples
terms.scope: For towers terminated by spires, includes tower, spire, and lantern.

terms.label: Railroad locomotives
terms.scope: For images that focus on the exterior or interior of locomotives.

terms.label: Photograph albums
terms.scope: Albums specially designed to hold photographs or albums containing photographs. Both empty and filled albums are included.

terms.label: Post offices
terms.scope: For images that focus on facilities. Search under POSTAL SERVICE for activities.

terms.label: Plazas
terms.scope: Open places in towns; public squares.

terms.label: Waterfronts
terms.scope: For images that focus on land beside water, whether inhabited or uninhabited.

terms.label: Tents
terms.scope: For tents used by soldiers, campers, nomads, etc.

terms.label: Galleries & museums
terms.scope: Includes activities, structures, and objects displayed.

terms.label: Spectators
terms.scope: People looking at or witnessing particular events or activities.

terms.label: Oceans
terms.scope: For the Atlantic, Pacific, Indian, Arctic, and Antarctic oceans.

terms.label: Sailors
terms.scope: For personnel of all types of vessels. Double index under the service for military personnel.

terms.label: Military personnel
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --MILITARY SERVICE used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A), and with names of persons (Appendix B). Search also under the subdivision --MILITARY PERSONNEL used with names of wars (Appendix C) and the subdivision --PEOPLE used with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

terms.label: Street railroads
terms.scope: For railroads within cities. Search under ELECTRIC RAILROADS for street railroads between cities and under CABLE RAILROADS for street railroads powered by cable.

terms.label: Grooms (Weddings)
terms.scope: For images which focus on persons. Search under WEDDINGS for activities.

terms.label: Tombs & sepulchral monuments
terms.scope: For constructions over or around burial sites. Search under GRAVES for excavations in the earth. Search also under the subdivision --TOMB used with names of persons (Appendix B).

terms.label: Lumber industry
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Schools
terms.scope: Includes elementary and secondary educational facilities. May include activities.

terms.label: Weddings
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --MARRIAGE used with names of persons (Appendix B).

terms.label: Mining
terms.scope: Includes activities and sites where mining is taking place. Search also under the subdivision --INDUSTRIES used with names of indigenous peoples (Appendix A).

terms.label: Employees
terms.scope: For persons identified as working for another, but where the nature of the activity, occupation, business or industry is not known. Search also under --STAFF used with names of persons (Appendix B) and --PEOPLE used with names of corporate bodies (Appendix D).

terms.label: Cattle
terms.scope: Includes domesticated calves, heifers, and steers. Also includes mixed groups of cattle and cows and bulls, if their sex cannot be determined.

terms.label: Airplanes
terms.scope: Includes commercial, private, and military airplanes.

terms.label: Residential streets
terms.scope: For views of streets in residential areas. Search under DWELLINGS for images that focus on buildings.

terms.label: Signs (Notices)
terms.scope: Lettered boards or other displays used to give directions or information, to identify a place of business or public facility, or to give warnings or directions. Textual or symbolic rather than pictorial.

terms.label: Presbyterian churches
terms.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

terms.label: Couples
terms.scope: For couples not known to be husband and wife.

terms.label: Industrial facilities
terms.scope: Search under INDUSTRY (or NTs) for activities.

terms.label: Books
terms.scope: Form: Published non-periodical volumes in bound codex form, usually with 49 or more pages. Search also under terms beginning with BOOK. SUBJECT: For images that focus on books. Search under READING for activities.

terms.label: Construction
terms.scope: For the process of building and types of construction. Search under CONSTRUCTION INDUSTRY for the construction business. Search also under the subdivision --ENGINEERING & CONSTRUCTION used with names of wars (Appendix C).

terms.label: Medals
terms.scope: Pieces of metal often resembling coins and having a stamped design that is issued to commemorate a person or event or awarded for excellence or achievement.

terms.label: Cemeteries
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --CEMETERIES used with names of wars (Appendix C).

terms.label: Shipwrecks
terms.scope: For the destruction or loss of a ship and the remains of destroyed or sunken vessels. Search under NAVAL WARFARE for vessels damaged as a result of war.

terms.label: Caves
terms.scope: Includes the activity of exploring caves.

terms.label: Platinum prints
terms.scope: Photographic prints on paper sensitized with platinum salts. Introduced commercially in 1879 as Platinotypes. Papers manufactured until World War I; revived by photographers who coat their own paper.

terms.label: Electric lines
terms.scope: Power lines used for transmission and distribution of electricity.

terms.label: Catholic churches
terms.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

terms.label: Historic sites
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --HISTORIC SITES used with names of wars (Appendix C).

terms.label: Balconies
terms.scope: For platforms (usually unroofed) that project from the wall of a building, enclosed by a parapet or railing.

terms.label: Terraces (Land use)
terms.scope: For level spaces supported in one or more places by a wall or bank and the practice of shaping the earth into this form.

terms.label: Fishing
terms.scope: For the subject of fishing in general and fishing as a local livelihood. Includes portraits of fishermen with their catch. Search under FISHING INDUSTRY for large-scale fishing. Search also under the subdivision --SUBSISTENCE ACTIVITIES used with indigenous peoples (Appendix A).

terms.label: Older people
terms.scope: This heading may be further subdivided by the subdivisions used for classes of persons (Appendix A).

terms.label: Battlefields
terms.scope: Battle sites after the time of fighting. Search under CAMPAIGNS & BATTLES and under the names of conflicts for images at the time of battles. Search also under the subdivision --BATTLEFIELDS used with names of wars (Appendix C).

terms.label: Columns
terms.scope: Includes both supporting pillars and free-standing shafts.

terms.label: Sports
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --SPORTS used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups and with classes of persons (Appendix A), with names of persons (Appendix B), and with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

terms.label: Historic buildings
terms.scope: Buildings generally or formally recognized as historically significant for their associations, materials, methods of construction, or other factors.

terms.label: Clearing of land
terms.scope: Removal of timber and bushes from land. Search under RECLAMATION OF LAND for bringing wild, waste, or marshy land into a condition for cultivation or other use.

terms.label: Driveways
terms.scope: Private roads giving access from a public way to a building on abutting grounds.

terms.label: Swimmers
terms.scope: For swimmers not engaged in swimming. Use SWIMMING for activities.

terms.label: Architecture
terms.scope: For the subject of architecture (style, design, etc.) in general and the activities of architects. Search under FACILITIES (and NTs) and ARCHITECTURAL & SITE COMPONENTS for images that focus on structures and sites or elements thereof, under CONSTRUCTION for the process of building, and under CONSTRUCTION INDUSTRY for the construction business.

terms.label: Shipping
terms.scope: For activities involved in the packing, dispatch, and unloading of goods and commodities.

terms.label: Aerial views
terms.scope: Views from a high vantage point.

terms.label: Military service
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --MILITARY SERVICE used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A), and with names of persons (Appendix B).

terms.label: Hospitals
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Banks
terms.scope: For images that focus on buildings. Search under BANKING for individual or local banking activities and under BANKING INDUSTRY for large-scale banking or images related to the industry as a whole.

terms.label: Paintings
terms.scope: Narrower terms include both physical media and genre categories.

terms.label: Visits of state
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --TRAVEL used with names of persons (Appendix B).

terms.label: Markets
terms.scope: Includes both indoor and outdoor markets where many buyers and sellers are brought into contact.

terms.label: Color photographs
terms.scope: A general designation encompassing a variety of photographic processes that produce images across a broad color spectrum.

terms.label: Spires
terms.scope: For tall pyramidal, polygonal, or conical structures that rise from towers or roofs.

terms.label: Steamboats
terms.scope: For boats powered by steam used on inland waterways. Search under SHIPS for steamships.

terms.label: Military camps
terms.scope: For images that focus on sites and facilities. Search under MILITARY LIFE for activities.

terms.label: Posing
terms.scope: To assume postures for the purposes of portrait or modeling sessions.

terms.label: Dancers
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --DANCE used with ethnic, racial, and regional groups and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

terms.label: Rugby
terms.scope: Includes organizations and activities.

terms.label: Students
terms.scope: For high school and college students. Search under SCHOOL CHILDREN for younger students.

terms.label: Camping
terms.scope: For camping outside of organized camps and without permanent shelters. Search under CAMPS for organized camps and camping within permanent structures.

terms.label: Theatrical productions
terms.scope: For theater activities, including plays, monologues, etc. Search under THEATERS for images that focus on buildings. Search also under the subdivision --PERFORMANCES & PORTRAYALS used with the names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups and with classes of persons (Appendix A). Search also under the subdivisions --PORTRAYALS and --PERFORMANCES used with names of persons (Appendix B).

terms.label: Farming
terms.scope: For work activities on farms. Search under PLANTS and NTs for specific farm crops. Search also under the subdivision --SUBSISTENCE ACTIVITIES used with indigenous people (Appendix A).

terms.label: Rookeries
terms.scope: Breeding grounds or colonies of mammals or birds.

terms.label: Tintypes
terms.scope: Direct-image photographs in which the collodion negative supported by a dark-lacquered thin iron sheet appears as a positive image. Popular mid-1850s through 1860s; in use through 1930s.

terms.label: Views
terms.scope: Depictions, in any media, usually of places and structures, made from a certain distance, and not necessarily intended to produce detailed information. Distinct from other information such as diagrams, working drawings, maps, and plans. A topographical image, showing a general aspect of a place.

terms.label: Politicians
terms.scope: For persons actively engaged in politics as managed by parties; often, persons primarily interested in political offices or the profits from them as a source of private gain.

terms.label: Autochromes
terms.scope: The Lumière brothers began marketing autochromes in 1907, and the color glass transparencies continued to be available into the 1930s.

terms.label: Animals
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --ANIMALS & PETS used with names of persons (Appendix B). Search also under the subdivision --ANIMALS used with names of wars (Appendix C).

terms.label: Passengers
terms.scope: For images that focus on travellers by some conveyance, e.g., boats, railroads, etc. Search under SIGHTSEERS or TOURISTS for passengers who are clearly sightseeing and under COMMUTERS for persons who travel regularly between one place and another.

terms.label: Actors
terms.scope: For male actors alone or groups of male and female actors. Search also under subdivision --PERFORMANCES used with names of persons (Appendix B).

terms.label: Boulders
terms.scope: Detached and rounded or much-worn masses of rock.

terms.label: Audiences
terms.scope: Groups or assemblies of listeners.

terms.label: Walls
terms.scope: Vertical architectural members used to define and divide spaces.

terms.label: Courthouses
terms.scope: For images that focus on facilities. Search under JUDICIAL PROCEEDINGS for activities.

terms.label: Military parades & ceremonies
terms.scope: Parades, rites, and ceremonies for, by, and of the military.

terms.label: Pools
terms.scope: Still bodies of water smaller than ponds of natural formation, either permanent or temporary.

terms.label: Historical pageants
terms.scope: Elaborate, usually open-air, exhibitions or spectacles that are marked by colorful costumes and scenery, and consist of a series of tableaux as representations of important events in the history of a community.

terms.label: Archaeological sites
terms.scope: For ancient structures still largely intact and remains of ancient structures; also includes active excavations. Search under ANTIQUITIES for relics (coins, etc.) of ancient times. Search under RUINS for remains of structures not of ancient times and under ABANDONED BUILDINGS for vacant, possibly dilapidated buildings. Search also under the subdivision --ANTIQUITIES & ARCHAEOLOGICAL SITES used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

terms.label: Rowing
terms.scope: For activity of rowing where vessel is not a rowboat, or where vessel is not visible. Search under TEAM ROWING for crew or team rowing and under ROWING RACES for races or regattas involving rowing. Search under ROWERS for rowers not engaged in the activity.

terms.label: Fords (Stream crossings)
terms.scope: Includes the activity of fording.

terms.label: Dance
terms.scope: For the subject of dance in general and the activity of dancing. Search also under the subdivision --Dance used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

terms.label: Rifles
terms.scope: For firearms that are fired from the shoulder.

terms.label: Ambrotypes
terms.scope: Direct-image photographs; the chemically reduced collodion glass negative packaged against a dark background appears as a positive. Commonly in a case; popular mid-1850s to mid-1860s.

terms.label: Merchandise displays
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivisions --EXHIBITIONS & DISPLAYS and --PRODUCTS used with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

terms.label: Seascapes
terms.scope: Works depicting the ocean or other large body of water where the water itself dominates the scene. When lesser bodies of water are depicted, use LANDSCAPES. When ships, shipbuilding, or harbors are depicted, use MARINES (VISUAL WORKS). [AAT]

terms.label: Bunkers
terms.scope: Fortified chambers, mostly below ground, often built of reinforced concrete and provided with openings for guns.

terms.label: Advertising
terms.scope: For the general activity of advertising (calling attention to something, usually by announcement).

terms.label: Firearms
terms.scope: For weapons from which missiles, as bullets, balls, or shells, are hurled by the action of explosives.

terms.label: Vases
terms.scope: For vessels, commonly decorative or for flowers.

terms.label: Tea
terms.scope: Includes the activity of tea drinking.

terms.label: Celebrations
terms.scope: Includes festivities associated with major events and holidays, as well as smaller festivities such as birthday parties. Search also under the subdivision --COMMEMORATION used with the names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and classes of persons (Appendix A); with names of persons (Appendix B); with names of wars (Appendix C); and with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

terms.label: Woodcutting
terms.scope: For the activity of cutting, splitting, chopping, or sawing trees and branches.

terms.label: Rugs
terms.scope: Textiles with thick, heavy fabric with nap or pile, used as a floor covering.

terms.label: Automobile industry
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Entertainment
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --PERFORMANCES & PORTRAYALS used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A). Search also under the subdivision --PERFORMANCES used with names of persons (Appendix B).

terms.label: Cages
terms.scope: Includes enclosures resembling a cage in form or purpose.

terms.label: Penstocks
terms.scope: Valve or gate that regulates flow of water through a sluice; or a pipe for conveying water to a power plant.

terms.label: Pipes (Smoking)
terms.scope: A long tube or hollow body for smoking tobacco or other substances.

terms.label: Rites & ceremonies
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --SPIRITUAL LIFE used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A). Search also under the subdivision --RITES & CEREMONIES used with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

terms.label: Recreation
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --SOCIAL LIFE used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups and with classes of persons (Appendix A), with names of persons (Appendix B), and with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D). Search also under the subdivision --SPORTS used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups and with classes of persons (Appendix A), and with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

terms.label: Forts & fortifications
terms.scope: Fortified places occupied by troops or permanent army posts. Includes activities & structures.

terms.label: Rotundas
terms.scope: For round buildings, especially ones covered by domes; also, large round rooms and large central areas (as in hotels).

terms.label: Landslides
terms.scope: Includes the event and any resulting damage.

terms.label: Bonnets
terms.scope: Head coverings for women or small children made of cloth or straw usually tied under the chin with ribbons or strings and made with or without a brim.

terms.label: Laundry
terms.scope: For domestic and non-commercial activities, e.g., washing and ironing. Includes laundry work in institutions such as hospitals. Search under CLEANING ESTABLISHMENTS for activities in commercial laundries.

terms.label: Packtrains
terms.scope: Strings of animals for transporting supplies and equipment.

terms.label: Exhibition buildings
terms.scope: For images that focus on structures depicted at the time of the exhibition. Search also under the subdivision --BUILDINGS used with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D). Search under EXHIBITIONS for activities and general views.

terms.label: Convents
terms.scope: For local communities or houses of nuns.

terms.label: Art
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --ARTS & CRAFTS used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

terms.label: Pianos
terms.scope: Includes the activity of playing pianos.

terms.label: Methodist churches
terms.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

terms.label: Window displays
terms.scope: For images that focus on window dressings and displays. Search under SHOW WINDOWS for windows as a part of mercantile facilities rather than their displays.

terms.label: Vocational education
terms.scope: Includes on-the-job training and other activities and structures.

terms.label: Government officials
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --STAFF used with names of PERSONS (Appendix B).

terms.label: Digital images
terms.scope: Images composed of encoded picture elements (pixels). Includes scans made without a camera.

terms.label: Silhouettes
terms.scope: Images shown in profile in a single hue against a contrasting background; cut, drawn, painted, printed, or photographic; often portraits.

terms.label: Ornithological illustrations
terms.scope: Illustrations that document birds and bird habitats.

terms.label: Grandstands
terms.scope: A usually roofed stand for spectators at a race course or stadium.

terms.label: School children
terms.scope: For students below high school age depicted in the context of school activities.

terms.label: Self-portraits
terms.scope: Images of a person created by that same person.

terms.label: Advertisements
terms.scope: Public notices of the availability of goods or services through purchase or other means.

terms.label: Fish
terms.scope: For images of fish. Search under FISHING for activities.

terms.label: Photomechanical prints
terms.scope: Prints made from photographically prepared printing surfaces. Most have a distinctive dot or screen pattern, but some are continuous tone. Usually planographic.

terms.label: Camps
terms.scope: Includes activities and sites. Search under PRIVATE CAMPS for retreats, complexes of cabins, boathouses, etc., for families and friends. Search under CAMPING for camping outside of organized camps and without permanent shelters.

terms.label: Painting
terms.scope: Includes painting both as a trade and an artistic endeavor.

terms.label: Publicity photographs
terms.scope: Photos made for publicity or promotional purposes, unlike FASHION PHOTOGRAPHS, which emphasize the product being modeled, or GLAMOUR PHOTOGRAPHS, which focus on the physical attractiveness of the subject.

terms.label: Fires
terms.scope: For destructive fires. Includes the event and any resulting damage. Search under FIRE for the general subject of fire and for non-destructive fires.

terms.label: Bromoil prints
terms.scope: Bromide prints that are developed and then bleached and colored. Oil base pigment(s) is applied with a soft brush or a brayer, usually in repeated applications. Introduced in 1907.

terms.label: Animal feeding
terms.scope: Includes feeding of pets, livestock, etc.

terms.label: Embankments
terms.scope: A long natural or manmade bank or mound, esp. one raised for the purpose of carrying a road or a railway.

terms.label: Banners
terms.scope: Sheets of cloth, plastic, or paper intended for hanging or other public display.

terms.label: Volcanic eruptions
terms.scope: Includes the event and any resulting damage.

terms.label: Veterans
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --VETERANS used with names of wars (Appendix C).

terms.label: Musical instruments
terms.scope: Includes the activity of playing instruments. Search also under the subdivision --PERFORMANCES used with names of persons (Appendix B).

terms.label: Livestock
terms.scope: Farm animals raised for use and profit.

terms.label: General stores
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Pipes (Conduits)
terms.scope: Conduits for conducting liquids or gases.

terms.label: Bags
terms.scope: Sacks, usually rectangular in shape and made of paper, plastic, or cloth; often printed with manufacturer's name or advertisement.

terms.label: Agriculture
terms.scope: For the production of plants and animals for purposes of human consumption in some form.

terms.label: Violins
terms.scope: Includes the activity of playing violins.

terms.label: Transportation
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --TRANSPORTATION used with names of indigenous peoples (Appendix A) and with names of wars (Appendix C).

terms.label: Halftone photomechanical prints
terms.scope: Prints distinguished by patterns of dots or circular lines, or other indication of the screen interposed between the original image and the camera. Usually used to reproduce continuous tone originals, such as photographs, in books, newspapers, or other publications. First commercially available in the 1880s.

terms.label: Daguerreotypes
terms.scope: Direct-image photographs on silver-coated copper; introduced in 1839 and in general use until ca. 1860; distinctive mirror-like surface; commonly in a case.

terms.label: Water towers
terms.scope: Towers or standpipes serving as a reservoir to deliver water at a required head. Search under FIREFIGHTING EQUIPMENT for fire apparatus having a vertical pipe which can be extended to various heights, and supplied with water under high pressure.

terms.label: Boots
terms.scope: Footwear usually of leather or rubber that covers the foot and part or all of the legs.

terms.label: Ethnic groups
terms.scope: For races or large groups of people classed according to common traits and customs. See also Library of Congress Subject Headings for names of individual groups.

terms.label: Fire stations
terms.scope: Search under FIRES for activities.

terms.label: Tearooms
terms.scope: Restaurants where tea and light meals are served.

terms.label: Youth
terms.scope: The quality or state of being young. Search under CHILDREN or YOUNG ADULTS for young people. Search also under the subdivision --CHILDHOOD & YOUTH used with names of persons (Appendix B).

terms.label: Collotypes
terms.scope: Photomechanical prints introduced commercially in the 1860s; commonly used in book illustration; can be difficult to distinguish from actual photographs.

terms.label: Chapels
terms.scope: For chapels within churches or other buildings or for small, separate houses of worship sometimes associated with a church.

terms.label: Waterwheels
terms.scope: Any wheel made to rotate by action of water.

terms.label: Hydraulic mining
terms.scope: Includes activities and sites.

terms.label: Testing
terms.scope: For the testing of things. Search under EXAMINATIONS for the testing of persons.

terms.label: Funeral rites & ceremonies
terms.scope: For rites and ceremonies in memory of persons, with the deceased present; also for customs associated with mourning. Search under MEMORIAL RITES & CEREMONIES for rites and ceremonies without the presence of the deceased. Search also under the subdivision --DEATH & BURIAL used with names of persons (Appendix B).

terms.label: Murals
terms.scope: Paintings that dominate a wall or ceiling surface.

terms.label: Manners & customs
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --SOCIAL LIFE used with names of ethnic, racial and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A), with names of persons (Appendix B), and with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D). Search also under the subdivision --SOCIAL ASPECTS used with names of wars (Appendix C).

terms.label: Maps
terms.scope: Graphic delineations at a set scale, of all or part of the earth or another celestial sphere indicating the relative position of selected artificial and natural features.

terms.label: Fruit
terms.scope: For the subject of edible fruit in general and images that focus on fruit.

terms.label: Boat & ship industry
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Facilities
terms.scope: Something that is built, installed, or established to serve a particular purpose; often combines structure(s) and developed terrain; may include activities.

terms.label: Sanatoriums
terms.scope: Establishments for the treatment of the sick, especially if suffering from chronic disease, e.g., alcoholism, tuberculosis, requiring protracted care. Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Taverns (Inns)
terms.scope: Primarily 17th to early 19th century English and American places for eating, drinking, and public accomodations. Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Psychiatric hospitals
terms.scope: For images that focus on buildings. Search under MENTALLY ILL PERSONS for activities

terms.label: Railroad cars
terms.scope: For images that focus on the exterior and interior of railroad cars. Search under RAILROADS for general views of trains.

terms.label: Police
terms.scope: Includes policemen, mixed groups of policemen and policewomen, as well as police departments and occasions when gender is not specified.

terms.label: Track athletics
terms.scope: Various competitive athletic events (as running, jumping, and weight throwing) performed on a running track and on the adjacent field.

terms.label: Public baths
terms.scope: Public buildings for bathing. Includes activities and structures. Search under BATHHOUSES for public facilities containing dressing rooms.

terms.label: Wool industry
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Guides & scouts
terms.scope: Includes those who act as guides or scouts in non-military contexts, e.g. expeditions, exploration, and travel. Search under MILITARY SCOUTS for scouts operating in military contexts.

terms.label: Arcades (Shopping facilities)
terms.scope: For covered passageways or avenues along which are located rows of shops. Search under ARCADES (ARCHITECTURAL COMPONENTS) for images that focus on series of arches.

terms.label: Gasoline pumps
terms.scope: For gas pumps not associated with service stations. Search under AUTOMOBILE SERVICE STATIONS for those that are part of the station.; AAT: identical

terms.label: Bishops
terms.scope: High ranking prelates in the Christian church; usually administers a diocese.

terms.label: Composite photographs
terms.scope: Photographs made through multiple exposure of negatives, sandwiching negatives, or other means of combining negatives. Examples include: a print made by combining cloud and landscape negatives and works by Henry Peach Robinson or Jerry Uelsmann.

terms.label: Swings
terms.scope: Seats suspended from above, on which one may ride back and forth in an arc for recreation; also for single suspended ropes and other kinds of swings used for recreation.

terms.label: Suspension bridges
terms.scope: For bridges where the roadway is suspended from two or more cables, usually passing over towers.

terms.label: Automobile service stations
terms.scope: Includes gasoline pumps which are part of a service station.

terms.label: Balusters
terms.scope: One of a number of short, vertical members used to support a stair handrail or coping.

terms.label: Teenagers
terms.scope: For persons in the general age range of thirteen to eighteen years. This heading may be further subdivided by the subdivisions used for classes of persons (Appendix A).

terms.label: Reclamation of land
terms.scope: Bringing wild, waste, or marshy land into a condition for cultivation or other use. Search under CLEARING OF LAND for removal of timber and bushes from land.

terms.label: Shelters
terms.scope: Structures that cover or provide protection from the elements.

terms.label: Lodging houses
terms.scope: Houses in which sleeping accommodations are provided.

terms.label: Theaters
terms.scope: For images that focus on facilities. Search under THEATRICAL PRODUCTIONS for activities.

terms.label: Fishing & hunting gear
terms.scope: For images that focus on the equipment. Search under FISHING and under HUNTING for activities using the equipment.

terms.label: Helmets
terms.scope: For various protective head coverings usually made of a hard material to resist impact.

terms.label: Military life
terms.scope: Includes all aspects of military life, e.g., training, reviews, camp life, etc. Search also under the subdivision --MILITARY LIFE used with names of wars (Appendix C).

terms.label: Floods
terms.scope: Includes the event and any resulting damage.

terms.label: War casualties
terms.scope: For images that focus on dead and wounded persons. Search under MEDICAL ASPECTS OF WAR for relief and medical care of casualties. Search also under the subdivision --CASUALTIES or --MEDICAL ASPECTS used with names of wars (Appendix C).

terms.label: Pipelines
terms.scope: Lines of pipe with pumping machinery and apparatus for conveying liquids, especially petroleum.

terms.label: Military vehicles
terms.scope: Search also under AIRCRAFT or VESSELS and their NTs for specific types of vehicles used in a military context.

terms.label: War damage
terms.scope: For images made to show damage or views after the fighting. Search also under the subdivision --DESTRUCTION & PILLAGE used with names of wars (Appendix C).

terms.label: Retaining walls
terms.scope: Walls constructed to resist lateral loads, such as banks of earth.

terms.label: Teachers
terms.scope: For teachers at all levels.

terms.label: Bathhouses
terms.scope: Public facilities containing dressing rooms. Includes activities and structures. Search under PUBLIC BATHS for public buildings for bathing.

terms.label: Opalotypes
terms.scope: Photographs on opal (opaque white) glass; popular in the 1880s to early 1900s. Made either by transferring a carbon print onto the glass or by exposing a light-sensitive emulsion on the opal glass to a negative.

terms.label: Naval parades & ceremonies
terms.scope: For civilian or military parades on water. Search under MILITARY PARADES & CEREMONIES for land parades sponsored by the navy.

terms.label: Pets
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --ANIMALS & PETS used with names of persons (Appendix B).

terms.label: Accordions
terms.scope: Includes the activity of playing accordions.

terms.label: Graves
terms.scope: For excavations in the earth used for burials. Search under TOMBS & SEPULCHRAL MONUMENTS for constructions over or around burial sites.

terms.label: Photograms
terms.scope: Photographs made by laying objects on photographic paper or film and exposing them to light.

terms.label: Photographic studios
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Sugar plantations
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Fuelwood
terms.scope: For images that focus on segments of small trees and branches to be used for fires, including woodpiles. Search under WOODCUTTING for activities.

terms.label: Plaques
terms.scope: Inscribed, usually metal tablets placed (as on a building or post) to identify a site or commemorate an individual or event.

terms.label: Insurance companies
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Synagogues
terms.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

terms.label: Lodges
terms.scope: Small houses in parks, forests, or domains; temporary habitations.

terms.label: Dairying
terms.scope: For the production, processing, and manufacture of milk and its products. Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Couches
terms.scope: Long seating furniture with a back support and one end, generally used for reclining, not sitting.

terms.label: Grocery stores
terms.scope: A small retail market selling food and other merchandise, run by a grocer. Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Tennis players
terms.scope: For tennis players not engaged in the activity of the game. Search under TENNIS for activities.

terms.label: Equipment
terms.scope: Devices or tools used in an activity or operation. Search also under the subdivision --EQUIPMENT & SUPPLIES used with names of wars (Appendix C), and with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

terms.label: Forge shops
terms.scope: Search under FORGING for activities.

terms.label: Musicians
terms.scope: Includes portraits of musicians with instruments.

terms.label: Kiosks
terms.scope: For small light structures with one or more open sides, especially as a newsstand or telephone booth. Also for free-standing columns on which announcements of concerts, plays, etc., are glued.

terms.label: Mosques
terms.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

terms.label: Resorts
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Gelatin silver film transparencies
terms.scope: Film transparencies having gelatin as the binder, holding silver as the final image material.

terms.label: Terraces
terms.scope: For flat roofs or open platforms and relatively level paved or planted areas adjoining buildings.

terms.label: Hitching posts
terms.scope: Fixed posts to which horses can be fastened.

terms.label: Botany
terms.scope: For the subject of botany in general and the activities of botanists.

terms.label: Tobacco shops
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Moonlight
terms.scope: For geographic location on which moonlight falls.

terms.label: Meat industry
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Drugstores
terms.scope: Retail stores where medicines are compounded and dispensed and miscellaneous articles, e.g. food, cosmetics, and film, are sold. Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Libraries
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Business enterprises
terms.scope: For organizations and undertakings concerned with the supply and distribution of goods and services. Search under COMMERCIAL FACILITIES (and NTs) for facilities where goods and services are bought and sold.

terms.label: Montages
terms.scope: Compositions made by juxtaposing or superimposing multiple pictures to create a single image. May be produced by pasting together whole or partial pictures or by recopying multiple images through photography or scanning. Includes photomontages in both the commercial graphic arts and fine art contexts.

terms.label: Masks
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --DEATH MASK used with names of persons (Appendix B).

terms.label: Vegetables
terms.scope: For the subject of edible vegetables in general and images that focus on vegetables.

terms.label: Floats (Parades)
terms.scope: Decorated platforms used in parades on land or sea.

terms.label: Sleds & sleighs
terms.scope: Includes the activity of sledding and riding in sleighs, and pulling of sledges for entertainment or work.

terms.label: Art exhibitions
terms.scope: Includes activities, structures, and sites.

terms.label: Governors
terms.scope: For the subject of the governship in general and for incumbents.

terms.label: Seaplanes
terms.scope: Airplanes designed to take off from and land on the water.

terms.label: Ranches
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Coal mining
terms.scope: Includes activities and sites.

terms.label: Athenaeums
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Bars
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Church schools
terms.scope: For elementary and secondary schools operated under church auspices, control, or support. Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Disasters
terms.scope: Includes the event and any resulting damage. Search also under the subdivision --DISASTERS used with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

terms.label: Nursing homes
terms.scope: Privately operated establishments where maintenance and personal or nursing care are provided for persons (as the aged or chronically ill) who are unable to care for themselves. Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Bird's-eye views
terms.scope: Graphic representations of scenes portrayed as if viewed from above at an oblique angle. If of a city or town, not generally drawn strictly to scale, they show street patterns, individual buildings, and major landscape features in perspective.

terms.label: Wallpapers
terms.scope: Decorative paper intended to cover the walls of a room.

terms.label: Balloons (Novelties)
terms.scope: For balloons other than vehicles.

terms.label: Urns
terms.scope: Vessels of various forms, usually with a foot or pedestal and used for holding liquids, for ornamental purposes, for preserving ashes of the dead after cremation and, anciently, for holding lots to be drawn.

terms.label: Ceremonial dancers
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --DANCE used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and classes of persons (Appendix A).

terms.label: Caravans
terms.scope: Companies of travelers with their animals, wagons, and equipment on a journey.

terms.label: Meetings
terms.scope: For planned gatherings. Search also under the subdivision --MEETINGS used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A), and with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

terms.label: Hair ornaments
terms.scope: Various types of ornaments, such as hairpins, decorative combs, beadwork, and ribbons worn by men or women.

terms.label: Abandoned buildings
terms.scope: For vacant, possibly dilapidated buildings. Search under RUINS for the remains of structures.

terms.label: Sick persons
terms.scope: Persons affected with unspecified diseases or ill health; also, persons awaiting or under medical treatment. Search under DISEASES and NTs for specific illnesses. Search also under the subdivisions --HEALTH used with names of persons (Appendix B) and --HEALTH & WELFARE used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

terms.label: Porticoes (Porches)
terms.scope: Covered entrances or galleries for buildings of certain scale and importance, usually associated with classical and neoclassical architecture.

terms.label: Snapshots
terms.scope: Photographs that seem to have been made without artistic pretensions; often made quickly with amateur equipment as a remembrance of people, places, or occasions.

terms.label: Handicraft
terms.scope: Activities requiring skill with the hands. Search also under the subdivision --ARTS & CRAFTS used with the names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

terms.label: Police stations
terms.scope: For images that focus on buildings. Search under POLICE for activities.

terms.label: Cafes
terms.scope: Usually small and informal establishments serving various refreshments, often partly outdoors.

terms.label: Anniversaries
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --COMMEMORATION used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups and classes of persons (Appendix A); with names of persons (Appendix B); with names of wars (Appendix C); and with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

terms.label: Foraging
terms.scope: Searching for food or provisions.

terms.label: Brass instruments
terms.scope: Includes the activity of playing brass instruments.

terms.label: Paper industry
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Photography
terms.scope: For the subject of photography in general and the activities of photographers.

terms.label: Tourists
terms.scope: For persons on organized tours. Search under SIGHTSEERS for persons who go about seeing sights of interest on their own.

terms.label: Storms
terms.scope: Includes the event and any resulting damage.

terms.label: Periodicals
terms.scope: Serials usually issued at regular intervals and more frequently than annually.

terms.label: Goggles
terms.scope: Protective eye coverings.

terms.label: Political issues
terms.scope: For political issues in general. Search also under headings for specific issues.

terms.label: Artillery (Weaponry)
terms.scope: For missile engines and weapons, as well as mounted guns as distinct from small arms.

terms.label: Photography industry
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Tide pools
terms.scope: Pools left by ebbing tides.

terms.label: Shoes
terms.scope: Footwear made of leather or similar material, reaching about to the ankle and having a heel of variable height.

terms.label: Actresses
terms.scope: For female actresses. For groups of males and females use ACTORS. Search also under the subdivision --PERFORMANCES used with names of persons (Appendix B).

terms.label: Capitals (Columns)
terms.scope: Molded or carved tops of columns, piers, or pillars.

terms.label: Plantations
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Fire fighting
terms.scope: For general views in which fire engines and equipment are in use.

terms.label: Icebergs
terms.scope: Huge, floating masses of ice, detached from glaciers.

terms.label: Marine terminals
terms.scope: Includes both freight and passenger terminals.

terms.label: Bells
terms.scope: Includes the activity of ringing bells.

terms.label: Halls
terms.scope: Large rooms for sleeping and family use; also the main rooms of a medieval house and large, central rooms in some 19th and 20th century English and American homes.

terms.label: Woodburytypes
terms.scope: Continuous tone photomechanical prints made by a carbon process introduced in the United States in 1870. Used through the 1890s, mainly for book illustrations. Difficult to distinguish from actual photographic prints, although slight surface relief may be visible.

terms.label: Orphanages
terms.scope: An institution for the care of orphans.

terms.label: Quarrying
terms.scope: Extraction of stone, marble, slate, etc., from quarries. Includes activities and sites.

terms.label: Mezzanines
terms.scope: Low-ceilinged stories between the two main stories of a building, especially intermediate or fractional stories that project in the form of a balcony over the ground story.

terms.label: Regattas
terms.scope: Rowing, speedboat, or sailing races, or organized series of such races.

terms.label: Bookstores
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: War
terms.scope: For the subject of war in general and for wars that cannot be identified by name. Search primarily under names of specific wars and relevant topical subdivisions (Appendix C). The subdivision --WAR is used with names of ethnic, racial and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A) only when the war cannot be identified.

terms.label: Robes
terms.scope: Long, loose garments, which tend to be of one piece worn for ordinary wear or for ceremonial or official occasions or as a symbol of office or profession.

terms.label: Surrenders
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --SURRENDERS used with the names of wars (Appendix C).

terms.label: Fire
terms.scope: For the subject of fire in general and non-destructive fires. Search under FIRES for destructive fires.

terms.label: Showrooms
terms.scope: Rooms where merchandise is exposed for sale or where samples are displayed.

terms.label: Stringed instruments
terms.scope: Includes the activity of playing stringed instruments.

terms.label: Architectural drawings
terms.scope: Graphic delineations made for the design and construction (or documentation of design and construction) of sites, structures, details, fixtures, furnishings, and decorations, as well as other objects designed by an architect or architectural office.

terms.label: Trumpets
terms.scope: Includes the activity of playing trumpets.

terms.label: Conversation
terms.scope: For images of persons engaged in casual talk.

terms.label: Amusement parks
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Cocoa industry
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Forestry
terms.scope: For the subject of forestry in general and the activities of foresters.

terms.label: Still lifes
terms.scope: Graphic representations of inanimate objects selected and arranged by the artist or photographer for a specific pictorial effect.

terms.label: Public speaking
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --PUBLIC APPEARANCES used with names of persons (Appendix B).

terms.label: Badges
terms.scope: Devices indicating support of a cause, achievements, or membership in a society or group. May be printed, photographic, plastic, metal, cloth, or other fabric; usually intended to be worn on the person.

terms.label: Masonry
terms.scope: Construction activity with materials such as stone, brick, concrete block, and tile.

terms.label: Stereograph industry
