terms.label: Music
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --MUSIC used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A). Search also under the subdivision --SONGS & MUSIC used with names of wars (Appendix C).

terms.label: Domestic life
terms.scope: People at home; also includes activities in the home or a home-like setting. Search also under the subdivision --DOMESTIC LIFE used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

terms.label: Game pieces
terms.scope: Objects manipulated by participants during the play of table and boardgames.

terms.label: Publicity
terms.scope: Acts or devices designed to attract public attention or support. Search also under the subdivision --PUBLIC RELATIONS used with names of corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

terms.label: Motion picture industry
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Screen prints
terms.scope: Prints made by forcing ink through a fine screen stencil onto paper or another surface. Art applications date from the 1930s; commercial ones from the 1920s.

terms.label: Furniture industry
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Sewing machines
terms.scope: Includes sewing activities.

terms.label: Bas-reliefs
terms.scope: Works of sculpture in which the projection of figures, ornaments, etc., from the background is slight, no part being entirely detached.

terms.label: Electric household appliances industry
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Household soap
terms.scope: Soap used in household cleaning tasks.

terms.label: Jewelry stores
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Gift shops
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Florist shops
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Clothing industry
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Tea industry
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Sporting goods industry
terms.scope: Manufacture and trade of sporting goods. Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: War work
terms.scope: For civilian work as part of a war effort. For the effect of war on industrial and commerical activity search under the subdivision --ECONOMIC & INDUSTRIAL ASPECTS or by ethnic, racial, regional groups, and classes of persons subdivisions used with names of specific wars (Appendix C). The subdivision --WAR used with the names of ethnic, racial and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A) is used only when the war cannot be identified.

terms.label: Tobacco industry
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Posters
terms.scope: Single or multi-sheet notices made to attract attention to events, activities, causes, goods, or services; also, purely decorative posters. For posting, usually in a public place; chiefly pictorial. Intended to make an immediate impression from a distance.

terms.label: Apartment houses
terms.scope: For apartment house structures; search under APARTMENTS for single units within apartment houses or living units not in apartment houses.

terms.label: Commercial art galleries
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Commerce
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --COMMERCE used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

terms.label: Blockades
terms.scope: Barriers set up by troops or ships to prevent ingress or egress; also restrictive measures to obstruct communication and cut off commerce with an enemy.

terms.label: Work camps
terms.scope: Includes volunteer camps.

terms.label: Quarreling
terms.scope: Search under FIGHTING for physical fighting.

terms.label: Cauldrons
terms.scope: Large, open vessel sometimes used over a fire.

terms.label: Grooming
terms.scope: Process of making neat or attractive either by oneself or by commercial services.

terms.label: Marriage
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --MARRIAGE used with names of persons (Appendix B).

terms.label: Coronations
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --CORONATION used with names of persons (Appendix B).

terms.label: Silos
terms.scope: Typically cylindrical structures usually sealed when full to exclude air and used for storing silage (fodder).

terms.label: Public utility companies
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Historical reenactments
terms.scope: For images representing enactments of specific historical events, such as battles, etc. Search under HISTORICAL DRAMAS for images representing dramatic productions or scenes (theatrical, film, radio, or television) of historical events or with historical settings that emphasize the dramatic. Search also under the subdivision --PERFORMANCES & PORTRAYALS used with ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

terms.label: Bungalows
terms.scope: One-story frame houses or summer cottages, often surrounded by covered verandas.

terms.label: Express highways
terms.scope: Major high speed, high capacity roads.

terms.label: Fuel tanks
terms.scope: Large containers for holding liquids or gases.

terms.label: Parlors
terms.scope: For rooms in hotels, clubs, or the like, reserved for guests who desire a greater degree of privacy than the public rooms provide, and for rooms in private homes reserved for the entertainment of visitors.

terms.label: Hunting & fishing clubs
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Copy art
terms.scope: Images made with photocopy machines, such as Xerox machines, that are original works rather than reproductions of other documents. Examples include multiple copy, personal use invitations as well as artists' works.

terms.label: Forging
terms.scope: Forming a metal into a particular shape by heating and hammering.

terms.label: Phosphate mining
terms.scope: Includes activities and sites.

terms.label: Astronomy
terms.scope: For the subject of astronomy in general and the activities of astronomers.

terms.label: Floor plans
terms.scope: Plans that represent horizontal sections cut through the walls and other vertical elements of a building at one or more levels. They demonstrate the shape and disposition of spaces, chambers, and structural components. They include information on placement and dimensions of features, such as doors, walls, built-in equipment, and room names.

terms.label: Cooperatives
terms.scope: Enterprises or organizations owned by and operated for the benefit of those using their services. Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Mascots
terms.scope: Persons, animals, or objects adopted by a group as a symbolic figure, especially to bring them good luck.

terms.label: Queues
terms.scope: Lines, especially of persons or vehicles.

terms.label: Gangplanks
terms.scope: A movable bridge used in boarding or leaving a ship at a pier.

terms.label: Street vendors
terms.scope: Includes people who sell goods from temporary locations on the street.

terms.label: Tobacco plantations
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Expedition photographs
terms.scope: Photographs intended to gather data or to document the activities of geological, geographical, anthropological, archaeological, or other scientific discovery expeditions.

terms.label: Banjos
terms.scope: Includes the activity of playing banjos.

terms.label: Pineapple plantations
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Coffers (Ceilings)
terms.scope: For recessed panels, especially forming with other panels a continuous pattern in a vault, ceiling, or soffit.

terms.label: Abyss
terms.scope: A bottomless pit or wide gulf.

terms.label: Barbershops
terms.scope: Search under BARBERING for activities outside of shops.

terms.label: Beer gardens
terms.scope: Eating and drinking establishments serving food and drink to individuals and families, and often serving as social centers. Originated in Germany and brought to the U.S. by German and East European immigrants.

terms.label: Rangers
terms.scope: Persons responsible for ranging over a region for its protection.

terms.label: Railroad passenger cars
terms.scope: For images that focus on the exterior or interior of passenger cars.

terms.label: Railroad freight cars
terms.scope: For images that focus on the exterior or interior of freight cars.

terms.label: Working class
terms.scope: For the class of people who work for wages, excluding managers and professionals; generally at lower end of economic scale.

terms.label: Commuters
terms.scope: For persons who travel regularly between one place and another. Search under PASSENGERS for general travelers.

terms.label: Fighting
terms.scope: For fistfights and other spontaneous fighting. Search under QUARRELING for verbal fighting.

terms.label: Ticket offices
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Tobacco pipe industry
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Interior decoration
terms.scope: Selecting and arranging the surface ornamentation and furnishings of an interior.

terms.label: Sketchbooks
terms.scope: Albums of drawings or paintings on pages bound together before the images were created.

terms.label: Singing
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --PERFORMANCES used with names of persons (Appendix B).

terms.label: Autographs
terms.scope: Names of people written in their own hand; stamped or printed signatures are not included.

terms.label: Slaughtering
terms.scope: For killing of domesticated animals in non-industrial contexts. Search under MEAT INDUSTRY for images of slaughter in industrial contexts; search under HUNTING for killing of non-domesticated animals.

terms.label: Coracles
terms.scope: Small, round or broad boats covered with skin or cloth used in the Near East and Great Britain.

terms.label: Fruit industry
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Folk dancing
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --DANCE used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and classes of persons (Appendix A).

terms.label: Galleries (Display spaces)
terms.scope: Rooms or spaces in museums, homes, or other buildings used for displaying artworks and other objects in a collection.

terms.label: Throwing
terms.scope: Propelling an object through the air using the hand and arm.

terms.label: Leaflets
terms.scope: Single printed sheets of paper that are folded and unbound, usually for free distribution.

terms.label: Screens
terms.scope: Moveable upright partitions, often decorative.

terms.label: Government employees
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --STAFF used with names of persons (Appendix B).

terms.label: Engineering drawings
terms.scope: Graphic delineations made for the design and construction (or documentation of design and construction) of civil, hydraulic, mechanical, and other engineering works or structural components. Distinguished from architectural drawings chiefly by the designation 'engineer' for the creator.

terms.label: Violoncellos
terms.scope: Includes the activity of playing violoncellos.

terms.label: Drilling
terms.scope: For drilling of holes in metal, wood, and other materials, as carried out for construction and manufacturing purposes. Search under BORING for the cutting of holes in earth or rocks to determine the nature of the strata penetrated or to create an outlet for oil, water, or gas.

terms.label: Bazaars
terms.scope: Markets consisting of rows of shops or stalls often found in Middle Eastern or Islamic countries.

terms.label: Bleachers
terms.scope: Main term

terms.label: Celebrities
terms.scope: Search also under types of celebrities, e.g. Actors, Musicians, Writers, etc.

terms.label: Voussoirs
terms.scope: Stones forming part of an arch; wedge-shaped, they make the arch self-supporting.

terms.label: Coffee plantations
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Caricatures
terms.scope: Images that portray in a critical or facetious way a real individual or group, or a figure representing a social, political, ethnic, or racial type. The effect is usually achieved through distortion or exaggeration of the features or form. Search also under the subdivision --CARICATURES used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A) and with names of persons (Appendix B).

terms.label: Mantels
terms.scope: Beams, stones, or arches serving as lintels to support the masonry above fireplaces.

terms.label: Wine industry
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Cards
terms.scope: Pieces of thin paperboard or stiff paper, which are flat, usually small and rectangular, and designed to convey messages or other information.

terms.label: Shoe industry
terms.scope: Includes all kinds of footwear. Includes activities and structures. Search under SHOEMAKING for small businesses.

terms.label: Embossed prints
terms.scope: Prints in which the image is formed largely by the paper being forced into relief by pressing it into the hollows of the printing plate or block, usually without ink.

terms.label: Labor unions
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Strikes
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --STRIKES used with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

terms.label: Civil service
terms.scope: For the subject of employment in branches of the public service which are not military, naval, legislative, or judicial.

terms.label: Camouflage (Military science)
terms.scope: Search also under the subdivision --CAMOUFLAGE used with names of wars (Appendix C).

terms.label: Stone carving
terms.scope: Carving stone to make sculpture or architectural elements.

terms.label: Packaging
terms.scope: Materials for the packing or protective wrapping of objects; usually contain information about the objects.

terms.label: Female figure drawings
terms.scope: Drawings of the human female body, other than portraits.

terms.label: Agricultural exhibits
terms.scope: For displays of agricultural products and technology in the context of an exhibition.

terms.label: Mayors
terms.scope: For the subject of the office in general and for incumbents.

terms.label: Fast food restaurants
terms.scope: For establishments where already prepared or readily prepared food that can be packaged for take-out is served; often run as part of chains or franchises.

terms.label: Harps
terms.scope: Includes the activity of playing harps.

terms.label: Rescues
terms.scope: For activities involved in freeing persons or animals from confinement, danger, and evil. Search under RESCUE WORK for the subject of rescue work in general and images that focus on the operations of rescue workers in accidents or disasters.

terms.label: Scrapbooks
terms.scope: Albums containing or intended to contain a variety of material, especially clippings or ephemera.

terms.label: Game cards
terms.scope: Cards designed for use with specific games and lacking standard suit systems. Examples include Old Maid and Game of Authors.

terms.label: Postage stamps
terms.scope: Government-authorized hand stamps, adhesive stamps, or meter markings intended as evidence of payment of postage. Also, stamps issued by private mail delivery companies to denote payment of their delivery fees.

terms.label: Electric railroads
terms.scope: For street railroads between cities.

terms.label: Committees
terms.scope: Body of persons appointed for a special function.

terms.label: Orthodox churches
terms.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

terms.label: Chaplains
terms.scope: Clergy who are officially attached to the Armed Forces, legislative bodies, institutions, courts, etc.

terms.label: Rosettes
terms.scope: Ornamental disks consisting of leafage or a floral design resembling a rose, usually in relief.

terms.label: Bugles
terms.scope: Valveless brass instruments that resemble trumpets and are used especially for military calls. Includes the activity of playing bugles.

terms.label: Demonstrations
terms.scope: Public displays, usually by a crowd, either in sympathy with or antagonism toward a cause, event, product, etc. Search also under the subdivision --RIOTS & DEMONSTRATIONS used with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

terms.label: Military depots
terms.scope: Places for the storage of military supplies and the reception and forwarding of military replacements.

terms.label: Comedies
terms.scope: For images representing dramatic productions or scenes (theatrical, film, radio, or television) which have humorous or amusing intent.

terms.label: Research
terms.scope: Studious examination or collection of information on a subject area.

terms.label: Pagodas
terms.scope: Tower-like storied structures, usually temples or memorials, common in India, China, Indochina, and Japan.

terms.label: War relief
terms.scope: Official or private aid to civilians during wars in the form of money or necessities.

terms.label: Medical aspects of war
terms.scope: For relief and medical care of casualties. Search under WAR CASUALTIES for images that focus on dead and wounded persons. Search also under the subdivision --MEDICAL ASPECTS used with names of wars (Appendix C).

terms.label: Armored vehicles
terms.scope: Vehicles with protective covering, usually steel plates.

terms.label: Hangings (Textiles)
terms.scope: Textiles hung to cover interior spaces, surfaces, or furniture, for protection, warmth, or decoration.

terms.label: Settlement houses
terms.scope: Urban institutions that provide educational, recreational, and social services to recent immigrants and the poor.

terms.label: Culverts
terms.scope: For arched drains or sewers.

terms.label: Prints
terms.scope: Images formed by transfer from one surface or source to another. Usually created with ink(s) and produced in multiple impressions.

terms.label: Pitchers
terms.scope: A container for holding and pouring liquids that usually has a lip or spout and a handle.

terms.label: Patriotism
terms.scope: Search also under subjects often associated with patriotic feeling, e.g., EAGLES, FLAGS, NATIONAL SONGS, etc.

terms.label: Convoys
terms.scope: Organized groups of ships or motor vehicles traveling together with or without escort.

terms.label: Tailors
terms.scope: For tailors away from the context of their work. Search under TAILORING for activities.

terms.label: Sheet music covers
terms.scope: Covers or first pages of unbound songs and other pieces of music on eight or fewer pages.

terms.label: Estates
terms.scope: For the grounds and outbuildings on estates. Search under DWELLINGS for dwellings on estates.

terms.label: Animal shows
terms.scope: Includes shows of farm animals or pets.

terms.label: Transportation industry
terms.scope: Manufacture and trade of vehicles. Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Memorial rites & ceremonies
terms.scope: For rites and ceremonies in memory of individuals or groups, without the presence of the deceased. Search under FUNERAL RITES & CEREMONIES for rites and ceremonies in the presence of the deceased. Search also under the subdivision --COMMEMORATION used with ethnic, racial, and regional groups and with classes of persons (Appendix A); with names of persons (Appendix B); and with names of wars (Appendix C).

terms.label: Brewing industry
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Panoramic views
terms.scope: Views that cover more area than usually can be seen in a single glance.

terms.label: Farmers' groups
terms.scope: Includes activities and structures.

terms.label: Locomotion
terms.scope: For the subject of locomotion in general.

terms.label: Devotional images
terms.scope: Pictures intended as aids to prayer or worship. Examples include the small lace paper embossed pictures common in Europe during the 1880s that featured saints or scenes from the life of Jesus Christ. Sometimes issued in sets or used in religious school. May have a brief religious text.

terms.label: Portfolios
terms.scope: Graphic materials issued in unbound sets with paper or board covers to contain them. Often have a loose title page or text introduction. Refers to both the container and its contents.

terms.label: Standards (Identifying artifacts)
terms.scope: Banners, flags, emblematic figures, or other objects displayed as the identifying symbol of a leader, public officer, or organization, such as the flag of a nation, the colors of a military unit, or the banner of a noble house.

terms.label: Perspective
terms.scope: The graphic technique of conveying an impression of depth by means of geometric projection using one or more vanishing points.

terms.label: Commemorations
terms.scope: Acts in honor or remembrance of an individual, a category of persons, or an event. Search also under the subdivision --COMMEMORATION used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A); with names of persons (Appendix B); with names of wars (Appendix C); and with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

terms.label: Presentation albums
terms.scope: Albums made to be dedicated or presented to a person or organization.

terms.label: Labels
terms.scope: Slips of paper, cloth, or other material affixed, or meant to be attached to something for identification, description, or decoration.

terms.label: Crayon enlargements
terms.scope: Photographic portraits, usually oval in shape, often life-size enlargements, made from the 1860s to 1920s by drawing extensively in charcoal or pastel over a faint photographic print.

terms.label: Building models
terms.scope: Miniature relief or three-dimensional representations of real or imaginary buildings. Search under ARCHITECTURAL MODELS for miniature representations in scale of structures or parts of structures made for the purpose of showing the result of actual architectural construction plans. Search under MODEL HOUSES for full-scale representations of houses planned to be constructed.

terms.label: Photogravures
terms.scope: Prints that faithfully imitate photographs or other continuous tone originals. Hand-pulled prints from plates with an aquatint grain have an irregular pattern of dotting; prints from screened gravure plates have a regular pattern of dots but, unlike halftone prints, ink varies in density. Introduced in 1879.

terms.label: Looms
terms.scope: Frames or machines for interlacing at right angles two or more sets of threads or yarns to form a cloth.

terms.label: Salvage
terms.scope: Saving or securing property, as well as property saved.

terms.label: Coupons
terms.scope: Printed slips of paper redeemable for goods or services.
